label: T4: Resonant Images + Memory
sections: 1.5 (T4) Resonant Images: How Phantasmata Structure Emotion, Thought, and Recollection
main_themes: phantasma activation: operating on stored images
phantasia vs memory distinction ('distinct temporal phases')
rattlesnake example: hearing rattle → phantasia activates snake image → fear
key_claims: Phantasia activates resonant motion to produce internal images
Phantasma functions as eikon (likeness) — not identical to memory
Memory and phantasia have 'distinct temporal phases': memory recalls, phantasia presents
The rattlesnake example shows phantasia enabling fear through recognition without direct perception
notes: Key unit for Tension #2 (phantasia vs memory). The phantasia/memory distinction is asserted but not fully resolved.
